name: Lively
title: Lively: free Wallpaper Engine alternative
hook: Wallpaper Engine charges you five bucks to put live wallpapers on your PC. This app does it for free.

features.say: Drag in a video, a GIF or a web page, and it becomes your wallpaper.
It even works as your screensaver.
It pauses when a game goes fullscreen, so nothing slows down.

caption:
Wallpaper Engine charges $4.99. Lively puts live wallpapers on your PC for free 🖼

✅ Drag in a video, GIF or web page and it becomes your wallpaper
✅ Works as a screensaver too
✅ Pauses automatically when a game goes fullscreen
✅ No subscription, no paywall, 100% free

💻 Windows

Comment "LIVELY" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
